personality_one_liner: An accessible, high-contrast, friendly cyber safety companion designed for rural youth with low literacy and low-end Android phones.

spacing.rule: Generous touch targets (min 56pt) and comfortable vertical rhythm for low literacy and accessibility.

do's: Use subtle glass effect on sticky headers and bottom tab bar over scrolling content
Ensure high-contrast translucent tinted base for foreground readability
dont's: Never blur body text or form inputs
Never use glass without a solid tinted background fallback for low-end Android

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Main dashboard providing instant access to lessons, scam checking, live alerts, and emergency helplines.

states.loading: Showing skeleton cards for modules and quick scam scanner.
states.empty: No recent cached lessons. Tap 'Learn' to download offline packs.
states.error: Failed to load latest security feed. Showing offline cached alerts.

screens.layout: Top language switcher bar + greeting header + AI scam quick checker card + 4 large tile grid (Learn, Scam Feed, Quizzes, Helplines) with big icons and local language subtitles.

screens.name: Learn
screens.purpose: Short, audio-supported cyber safety lessons with big icons and simple bullet points for rural youth.

states.empty: No lessons available offline. Check connection to sync.
states.error: Could not load lessons. Retry button with offline cache fallback.

screens.layout: Category filter chips at top + vertical list of large lesson cards with progress rings, estimated time, and audio play button.

screens.name: LessonDetail
screens.purpose: Immersive lesson view featuring big visual illustrations, simple steps, and interactive voice narration.

states.loading: Loading lesson media and text translations.
states.error: Failed to load lesson. Retry button.

screens.layout: Full-bleed hero banner with gradient scrim + key takeaway cards + step-by-step pictorial guide + 'Take Quiz' sticky bottom CTA.

screens.name: ScamChecker
screens.purpose: AI scam message analyzer where users paste suspicious SMS/WhatsApp text to receive an instant Safe/Suspicious/Scam verdict.

states.loading: AI analyzing text patterns and sender heuristics...
states.empty: Paste a suspicious message or tap an example below.
states.error: Network timeout. Ensure offline scanning cache is active.

screens.layout: Header title + large text input box with paste shortcut + quick example chips ('Bank OTP Scam', 'Lottery Win SMS') + prominent 'Check Safety' button + verdict result card.

screens.name: ScamFeed
screens.purpose: Live or cached feed of latest trending online scams in India with clear warning badges.

states.empty: No active scam alerts in this region.
states.error: Unable to refresh feed. Showing last cached alerts.

screens.layout: Warning banner at top + chronological feed of scam alert cards featuring severity tags ('High Risk'), description in selected language, and share button.

screens.name: Helplines
screens.purpose: Direct directory of Indian cyber crime helplines (1930, CyberDost) with one-tap calling.

states.error: Failed to load numbers. Retry button.

screens.layout: Emergency SOS banner at top with 1930 tap-to-call button + categorized list of national and state cyber helplines with big phone icons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build Surakshit Digital as an offline-friendly, multilingual Expo React Native app with FastAPI backend.
Support English, Hindi (हिन्दी), Marathi (मराठी), and Gujarati (ગુજરાती) via an easy in-app language switcher at the top of the home screen.
Implement low-literacy UX: large touch targets (min 56pt), big icons, minimal text, and high contrast botanical/ceramic color palette.
Never hardcode text; use a robust localization dictionary for all strings across all 4 languages.
Provide a dedicated AI scam message checker screen where users paste SMS/WhatsApp text and get a clear Safe/Suspicious/Scam verdict with 2-3 simple tips.
Include a helpline directory with one-tap calling (e.g. 1930 National Cyber Crime Helpline).
Ensure robust Loading, Empty, and Error states for every screen with offline caching fallback.
